statement.p: Let T be an linear transformation from {\mathbb R}^r to {\mathbb R}^s. Let A be the matrix associated to T.
Fill in the correct answer for each of the following situations.

li.p: The row-echelon form of A has a pivot in every column.
Two rows in the row-echelon form of A do not have pivots.
Every row in the row-echelon form of A has a pivot.
The row-echelon form of A has a row of zeros.
There is not enough information to tell.
